primitive.relation: Exact finite-poset cover-minor unavoidability: one natural threshold d chosen before all finite posets, and every poset whose dimension is not at most d (GTBase.posets, realizers may be empty) has H as a minor of its cover graph, host before pattern (upstream minor). d = 0, empty carriers and empty graphs allowed; no planarity or width condition on H; not induced minors, subdivisions or the exact-order tournament unavoidability of Digraph.conjectures.unvd.unavoidable, which stays a deferred distinct contract.

tournament-exact-order.note: Every tournament with exactly N vertices contains an injective arc-preserving copy of D; a directed exact-order contract with its own unvd/X221 chain. Left byte-for-byte unchanged for its later directed family; registry inclusion classifies the normalized namesake only.

upstream_audit.note: No installed upstream or GTBase poset-unavoidability primitive (path_review installed-source search). The single consuming area keeps it in Minor foundations; GTBase.posets (finite_poset, poset_cover_graph, poset_dimension_at_most) and upstream minor/minor_trans are reused unchanged, and no generic unavoidability abstraction or realizer convention change is introduced.
